text: 金十数据8月2日讯，中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议指出，金融高水平开放稳步推进。优化企业境外放款、银行境外贷款和人民币跨境同业融资政策。创设境外央行回购工具。便利国际优质主体来华发行熊猫债，上半年熊猫债发行超过1600亿元。人民币跨境支付体系建设取得积极进展。支持上海、香港国际金融中心建设。支持雄安新区、西部陆海新通道建设。深化外汇便利化改革，扩大跨境贸易高水平开放试点范围。完善企业汇率风险管理服务。
text_en: Jin Shi Data, Aug 2 – The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference. The meeting noted steady progress in high-level financial opening. Policies for corporate overseas lending, bank overseas loans, and RMB cross-border interbank financing were optimized. An overseas central bank repo tool was created. High-quality international issuers were facilitated to issue panda bonds in China, with H1 issuance exceeding RMB 160 billion. Positive progress was made in building the RMB cross-border payment system. Support was given to the development of Shanghai and Hong Kong as international financial centers, and to the construction of Xiong'an New Area and the New Western Land-Sea Corridor. Foreign exchange facilitation reforms were deepened, with expanded pilot scope for high-level opening of cross-border trade. Enterprise exchange rate risk management services were improved.
